title: Japanese hitodama soul orbs

tellings.quote: Japanese concept of the hitoama but it's these uh plasma orbs

plain: Michels brings up hitodama, a Japanese idea of floating orbs believed to be souls, and describes them as 'plasma orbs.' He mentions it alongside The Boy and the Heron, a film by Hayao Miyazaki, while talking about UFOs, psychics and the afterlife with the parapsychology researcher Jeffrey Mishlove. He tells it himself, without naming a source, and he raises it because it would tie an old folk belief to the glowing orbs people report today.
